mode.description: phrase: the whole query as written. all_words: every word, anywhere.

element.description:
Only elements of this type (message, call, decision, todo, ...). The query then matches anywhere
inside the element, e.g. element=call with a file path finds every call that touched it.

attributes.description:
Attributes the element must have. A string matches part of the value; null only requires the
attribute, e.g. {"answer": null} on decisions.

sessions.description: Only these session ids. List this chat's own id to search it too.

include_excluded.description: Also search sessions excluded from project context.

oneOf.description: The whole query as one substring.
